name: price-statement-of-work
description: Writes a Statement of Work with the outcome, deliverables, testable acceptance criteria, the assumptions the price rests on, revision rounds, change triggers, the AI use and client data lines and plain commercial terms, with anything beyond plain terms marked for an adviser. Use for "run price-statement-of-work", "write a statement of work", "SOW for this project", "turn the proposal into a SOW", "stop scope creep", "acceptance criteria for the deliverables", "how many revision rounds", "AI line in the contract", part of the Pricing Under AI Pressure Pack by 90n.
